data.long_description:
Experience waterfront living in this spacious 2-bedroom apartment located in the heart of Dubai Marina. Situated on a high floor, this unfurnished residence offers a bright and well-designed layout with partial views of the Marina canal and surrounding community.

The apartment features generously sized living and dining areas, large windows allowing for plenty of natural light, and a private balcony where residents can enjoy the vibrant Marina atmosphere. Offered unfurnished, it provides the perfect opportunity to create a home that reflects your own style and preferences.

Residents of the building enjoy access to an excellent selection of lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, fully equipped gymnasium, padel court, table tennis area, children’s play area, jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, and 24-hour security and concierge services. The building also offers convenient access to dining options, a yoga studio, and direct connectivity to the Marina waterfront.

Ideally positioned in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities, the property is within close proximity to Marina Walk, JBR Beach, Dubai Marina Mall, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, and public transportation.
